1615.m: Copper painted in polychrome enamels. The numerous paillons may have been achieved by the use of a large silver foil sheet rather than individual small pieces of foil. Jean I Pénicaud is credited with being first to use this new technique, whereby a foil sheet was held in place by a layer of clear, colourless flux.
